name: Everyday service and disaster work
purpose: Start with the jobs people need to complete and the support that makes those jobs dependable.

name: Weather-ready kiosks and places
purpose: Shape the cabinet, location, access and maintenance around real weather and the people using it.

name: Energy and backup power
purpose: Make useful power available through the required conditions, with a measured energy budget and people ready to maintain it.

name: Connections and messages
purpose: Move the right information through available paths and show clearly when a message has reached its next person.

name: Information people can trust
purpose: Keep the source, time, authority, permissions and corrections with information people act on.

name: Software and device care
purpose: Build the working parts that store, display, exchange and recover information across the network.

name: Personal Aura and learning
purpose: Help people navigate the network, keep control of personal information and learn the next practical step.

name: Place models and practice exercises
purpose: Use a digital model of a place to understand evidence, compare choices and practise demanding situations.

name: Community and operating responsibility
purpose: Work out who owns, maintains, reviews and supports the service, respecting local and cultural authority.

name: Budget and continuing support
purpose: Price the equipment and continuing work, and match suitable funding to a service people can sustain.

name: Tests and field learning
purpose: Turn ideas into checkable results through demonstrations, measurements, exercises and field experience.

name: Project connections
purpose: Define useful connections to the wider ecosystem while keeping the kiosk and resilience network moving.

name: Working together and human review
purpose: Give people and AI assistants clear jobs, connected records and a dependable way to make decisions.
